apney perwerdigar kay naam ki tasbeeh kero jiss ki shaan sabb say oonchi hai ,
jiss ney sabb kuch peda kiya , aur theek theek banaya ,
aur jiss ney her cheez ko aik khaas andaz diya , phir raasta bataya ,
aur jiss ney sabz chara ( zameen say ) nikala ,
phir ussay kalay rang ka koorra bana diya .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumhen parhayen gay , phir tum bhoolo gay nahi ,
siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye .   yaqeen rakho woh khuli hoi cheezon ko bhi janta hai , aur unn cheezon ko bhi jo chupi hoi hain .
aur hum tumhen aasaan shariyat ( per chalney kay liye ) sahoolat den gay .
lehaza tum naseehat kiye jao , agar naseehat ka faeeda ho .
jiss kay dil mein Allah ka khof hoga , woh naseehat maaney ga ,
aur uss say door woh rahey ga jo bara bad-bakht hoga ,
jo sabb say bari aag mein dakhil hoga ,
phir uss aag mein naa maray ga , aur naa jiye ga .
falah uss ney pai hai jiss ney pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki ,
aur apney perwerdigar ka naam liya , aur namaz parhi .
lekin tum log dunyawi zindagi ko muqaddam rakhtay ho ,
halankay aakhirat kahen ziyada behtar aur kahen ziyada payedaar hai .
yeh baat yaqeenan pichlay ( aasmani ) saheefon mein bhi darj hai ,
Ibrahim aur musa kay saheefon mein .
